eventDetail.scope: The IEEE MCSoC Forum is a leading international venue dedicated to advancing multi‑core, many‑core, and heterogeneous computing systems. Its scope spans architectures, design methodologies, and emerging technologies that shape next‑generation computing platforms. Topics include multi‑core and many‑core processors, heterogeneous and reconfigurable systems, System‑on‑Chip and Network‑on‑Chip, chiplet‑based and 3D/2.5D integration, hardware/software co‑design, design automation, AI and machine‑learning accelerators, neuromorphic and brain‑inspired architectures, edge and embedded intelligence, high‑performance and energy‑efficient computing, security, reliability, and applications in IoT and cyber‑physical systems. The Forum fosters collaboration across architecture, circuits, systems, and software communities.
